conditional_patient_intervals.interpretation: Conditional patient percentile interval; historically viewed cohort; seed pairs overlap

limits: No altered cohort, labels, eligibility, thresholds, weights, architecture or checkpoint selection
No fold9/10, new raw preprocessing/downloads, or completed inference repeats
No best-pair selection, sweep, independent-confirmation, novelty or benchmark-win claim
Input view is controlled; objective, architecture and pretraining remain confounded. Report all five fits and adverse probability/threshold results. Do not revise framing to claim paradigm causality.
Intervals condition on these fitted models and are not selection adjusted.
